scenarios.title: Rafforzare l'accoppiamento resistivo tra TRIGGER e base
scenarios.hypothesis: The existing resistive coupling from N001 to N004 may be too weak; adding a parallel resistive branch between the trigger node and the transistor base should increase the base drive if weak coupling is the limiting factor.
